spec.title: Consumer Group Lag
spec.description:
Shows total unprocessed message lag per consumer group and topic by summing partition-level lag.
Represents how far behind the consumer group is from the latest Kafka offset (higher value = more backlog).

spec.title: Messages in (per second)
spec.description:
Derived rate of change of Kafka partition offsets aggregated per topic.
Approximates message production rate, but since it is based on a gauge, values may be influenced by partition resets, rebalances, and offset irregularities.

spec.title: Messages in (per minute)
spec.description:
Derived rate of change of Kafka partition offsets aggregated per topic.
Approximates message production rate, but since it is based on a gauge, values may be influenced by partition resets, rebalances, and offset irregularities.

spec.title: Consumer throughput (msgs/sec approx)
spec.description:
Derived rate of change of Kafka consumer group committed offsets over time.
Approximates message processing throughput but can vary based on commit frequency and batching behavior.

spec.title: Process CPU Usage
spec.description:
Shows average CPU usage of the process over a 5-minute window, derived from total CPU seconds consumed.
Represents approximate number of CPU cores used and smooths short-lived spikes for stable monitoring.

spec.title: Process Memory (RSS)
spec.description:
Shows average CPU usage of the process over a 5-minute window, derived from total CPU seconds consumed.
Represents approximate number of CPU cores used and smooths short-lived spikes for stable monitoring.

spec.title: Open FDs
spec.description:
Shows number of file descriptors currently opened by the process.
Useful for detecting socket/file handle leaks and resource exhaustion.Represents approximate number of CPU cores used and smooths short-lived spikes for stable monitoring.

spec.title: Open FDs %
spec.description:
Shows percentage of available file descriptors currently in use.
High values indicate risk of FD exhaustion and connection failures.Useful for detecting socket/file handle leaks and resource exhaustion.Represents approximate number of CPU cores used and smooths short-lived spikes for stable monitoring.

spec.title: Network I/O (RX + TX)
spec.description:
Shows process network throughput over time with receive traffic plotted as positive values and transmit traffic inverted as negative values.
Helps visualize bidirectional network flow on a single time series graph.Useful for detecting socket/file handle leaks and resource exhaustion.Represents approximate number of CPU cores used and smooths short-lived spikes for stable monitoring.
